subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, telemetry sample, and bridge guidance
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Shore <security@greenleafanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, telemetry sample, and bridge guidance

Hi Linda —

Thanks again for taking the short call this morning. To move forward with procurement and the security review, could you share the following items at your earliest convenience? We want to keep this initial ask minimal to avoid noise for your team.

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent): PDF copy of the full report, including the auditor cover page. If you have a bridge letter for the window between the report's end date and today, please include that too.

2) Audit window / period: please confirm the report's period (start/end dates) and whether you have a retainer or ongoing monitoring.

3) Telemetry sample (redacted): a 7–30 day sample of service telemetry that demonstrates operational signals we evaluate for our integration (examples attached in the guidance doc). If anything contains customer identifiers, please redact or replace with consistent pseudonyms — our guidance doc (attached) has recommended fields to include/exclude.

4) Minimal evidence bundle: service control matrix (CSV or JSON), data retention policy, and evidence of log retention/config (screenshot or export).

5) Transfer options: we can accept a secure Share link (Drive with restricted access), an SFTP drop, or an encrypted S3 link. If you prefer a service-to-service transfer, we can provide a one-time pre-signed S3 token.

I've attached a short intake form and a telemetry-sample-guidance.md with examples and a small checklist for redaction. If it's helpful, I also included a bridge letter template your procurement team can use.

Would you be able to share items 1–4 by Friday, 18 Jun? If that timeline is tight, let me know and we can scope down to just the SOC2 PDF + audit window first.

Thanks —

-- 
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
pri@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: telemetry-sample-guidance.md (text/markdown)]
[Attachment: redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Linda Shore <security@greenleafanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenleafanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, telemetry sample, and bridge guidance

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick clarifications from our side before we pull files:

- Audit window: Our latest Type II covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31; auditor is NorthBridge; no continuous monitoring currently.
- Telemetry sample: We can provide a 14-day sample, but need to confirm acceptable redaction. We usually strip/obfuscate customer_user_id and replace with hashed IDs — is that sufficient?
- Transfer: Procurement prefers SFTP or an encrypted S3 upload. We can do S3 presigned with AES-256.

Procurement looped in. If you can confirm the redaction rules we use (PII vs. non-PII) and whether a hashed ID is OK, we’ll start preparing the sample. Also — would you accept a partial package (SOC2 PDF + audit window + service matrix) this week, and telemetry the following week?

Best,
Linda
Senior Security Manager
Greenleaf Analytics
[Attachment: gl-redaction-policy-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Shore <security@greenleafanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, telemetry sample, and bridge guidance

Linda —

Thanks — hashed customer_user_id is fine. To make this low-friction, our recommended redaction rules (attached in telemetry-sample-guidance.md) are:

- Replace any customer identifiers with stable pseudonyms or hashed IDs (SHA256 acceptable)
- Remove raw payment identifiers, raw email addresses, national IDs, and SSNs
- Keep timestamps, event types, anonymized resource_ids, and latency/error codes
- If you can provide an attached CSV with column descriptions, that speeds review.

Partial package is perfectly fine — please send SOC2 PDF + audit window + service control matrix + retention policy first. We’ll accept telemetry next week (14-day sample is ideal).

For procurement: we can handle S3 presigned links. We’ll provide the upload credentials shortly — I’ll loop Marcus to share the S3 flow.

Sample procurement blurb (feel free to copy into your procurement email):
"Redwood requests the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), the audit period dates, and a minimal evidence manifest (service control matrix, retention policy). Telemetry samples should be redacted according to the guidelines attached; parties may transfer via encrypted S3 or SFTP."

Thanks again.

-- 
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, telemetry sample, and bridge guidance

Hi Linda / procurement team —

We’ve created a one-time presigned S3 upload for Greenleaf. Please upload the initial bundle to the following secure location: https://s3.redwood.ai/presign/GL-230-upload (link expires 72 hours).

- greenleaf_soc2_typeii_2026.pdf (full report)

Once you upload, reply here with the object keys and we’ll confirm receipt and next steps for telemetry. If you prefer SFTP instead, let us know and we’ll share credentials.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
